svg.title: Dalili 2.0 - system architecture
svg.desc: Clients, API and service, the LangGraph agent workflow, the AI agents, the deterministic engine, the MCP tool servers, real data providers, the recommender, telemetry and evaluation.
svg.text: An AI travel planner: the LLM understands, designs and explains · deterministic code guarantees · tools bring real facts · validators verify
Vanilla JS · 3-D globe · live trip board · English / Arabic
push to main → GitHub Actions → production
REST + SSE: node · tool · preview · done
auth (cookies) · rate limits · CSP / HSTS · size caps · request ids
every turn runs on a copy, then settles it:
preference memory: stated vs inferred, decay
no secrets in code: .env / Azure / GitHub secrets
every message, start to reply — the plan streams to the screen at finalize
places on the map · what's missing
Google → official site → menu → guide → AI
FX for every currency · airport transfers
a repair that adds problems is undone
refine once · kept only if better
re-plan only (pace, places, budget…) — no new search
the models reason and write · the code decides what is true
Azure AI Foundry · gpt-5-mini · Responses API · structured outputs
labelled AI fallback when live search fails
all money math, feasibility and scoring — checkable, repeatable
no model output is final where code can check
8 in-memory servers · 27 tools · timeouts · every call timed for "How I answered"
net.py · SSRF-safe fetch · response cache · per-turn search budget
Google Flights · Hotels · Maps · Events · Directions
MiniLM fine-tuned by distillation from gpt-5-mini → ONNX int8
every node, tool and model call timed, per turn
